To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the financial policy of the state is the most effective tool to improve the efficiency and productivity of the economy; (ii) in the process of the financial policy implementation, the budget system should be transparent and effective; (iii) the main purpose of the financial policy of Azerbaijan is to ensure the economic and social development of the state; (iv) for the realization of this purpose it is necessary to improve the financial system of Azerbaijan and its main components, namely, budget, tax system
the budget policy of Azerbaijan Republic is not fully transparent and it needs to be improved.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the directions of the productivity improvement of the fiscal policy under the present-day conditions.
the directions of improving the productivity of the fiscal policy under presentday conditions.
the directions of the improvement of the financial policy in Azerbaijan and the problems connected with the development of the budget institutions and the budget system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the financial policy is an important part of the economic system.
the financial policy of the country should be based on the economic and social development strategy of the state and the financial system should be developed in accordance with the strategy.
the financial policy is a set of measures aimed at the realization of economic and social goals of the country and the improvement of financial situation in the country.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

in the present-day conditions of the world economy the financial policy of the country should be based on the scientific principles and the financial policy should be directed on the improvement of the economic development of the country and the increase in the living standard of the population.
the financial policy is a part of the state policy and it is the instrument of the state management in economy, the state management in finance and the financial management in the state.
the financial policy should be considered in a broader context, which is the economy of the country as a whole and its development prospects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the financial policy of the state should be developed on the basis of the economic policy.
it will be possible to improve the efficiency of the budget system of Azerbaijan only by the implementation of the financial policy in accordance with social development.

the financial policy of the Republic of the Azerbaijan is in need of the radical changes and it is required to develop the effective financial system which is able to provide the realization of social and economic development goals.
